note: Instagram/Graph error (code, subcode) -> what the app does. Data, not code: a Meta change edits this file. Sources: error-codes page + rate-limiting page, read 2026-11-15. maybe=true: on media_publish this answer does NOT prove the post is absent (=> unsure). Unknown (code, subcode) => failed, or unsure on media_publish. Add rows only from a page or the owner's real test.

codes.why: media not ready: wait for FINISHED, then publish
unsupported video format: re-encode is the producer's job
media expired: a person re-queues with a new container
creation id missing or expired: retry once after 30 s
media not found (permission or expired token)
media URI could not be fetched (not expected: no video_url)
thumbnail offset out of range: fix post.thumb_offset_ms
spam restriction on publishing: a person must look
Instagram account restricted: a person must look
access token invalid or expired (general Graph; not in Instagram's table)
custom rate limit (subcode 1996 = odd request behaviour)
too many calls to this Page
too many calls to this Instagram account

upload_errors.why: processing failed: one new try from offset 0, else a new container
